guidance: The skill's own trigger set: 12 should-trigger queries across the three jobs (building or updating a career profile; tailoring a resume or cover letter to a posting; match-only questions; watching job sources and setting the automation preference) and 12 near misses that share the vocabulary (interview coaching, job search, generic templates, HR tooling, scraping scripts, CI workflows, unrelated coding).

Release gate: suite_threshold in Claude Code. Run with node tests/run-trigger-set.mjs (paid; --dry-run prints the plan). The format is the one agentic-developer-companion's tooling trigger-set reads, so that runner works too.

queries.query: I want to build a proper career profile I can generate resumes from later. Interview me about my jobs, what I achieved and my skills, and save it somewhere I can keep updating.
Here is a job posting for a Lead Software Engineer (React, TypeScript, 7+ years, leads a team of 6). Tailor my resume to it and write a cover letter: [posting pasted below]
I just got promoted to Staff Engineer at Brightline Payments as of last month. Update my profile so the next resume reflects it.
Attached is my old resume from 2024 (resume-2024.pdf). Pull the facts out of it into my profile and ask me about anything that is missing or out of date.
Am I a good fit for this ICU registered nurse night-shift position at Lakeside Regional? Which of their requirements am I missing? https://jobs.example.org/rn-icu-nights
apply to this one: Regional Sales Manager, Midwest, Kestrel Industrial Supply. need a resume and cover letter that hit their requirements (5+ yrs B2B, Salesforce, managed a team)
My brother is an electrician looking for a journeyman position. Can you help him put together a record of his work history and certifications so we can make resumes for different postings?
Check this resume draft against my profile: I think I may have rounded some numbers up and I do not want anything in there I cannot back up.
I have a profile from last year. Where is it stored, what does it contain, and is it complete enough to generate a CV for a product manager role?
Write a CV tailored to this posting (text below) for a data analyst role; keep my Tableau and SQL work front and centre and leave out the retail jobs.
Watch Acme Ledger's careers page on Greenhouse for frontend lead openings and have a draft resume ready for me whenever one appears.
Set it so you only alert me about matching jobs and never apply to anything on my behalf; I will review every draft myself.
Give me ten common behavioural interview questions for a senior engineer role and model answers using the STAR method.
Which job boards and recruiters are best for finding remote React roles in Europe right now?
Write a generic one-page resume template in Markdown with placeholders for name, experience and skills.
I got an offer of 145k base plus 10% bonus. How should I negotiate for more, and what is a reasonable counter?
Build a React component that renders a candidate's resume from a JSON object with sections for experience and education.
Our HR team needs a job description for a Lead Software Engineer opening. Draft the posting with responsibilities and requirements.
Explain the difference between a resume and a CV, and when to use each in the US versus the UK.
Parse this LinkedIn CSV export into a Postgres table with one row per connection and their current company.
Write a LinkedIn post announcing that I am open to work as a nurse practitioner, upbeat tone, under 150 words.
Review the applicant tracking system integration in src/ats/client.ts for error handling problems.
Write a Python script that scrapes Indeed search results into a CSV every hour.
Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs our Playwright suite nightly and posts failures to Slack.
